source: Good Sam directory (all unmatched MO rows read, not just PUBLIC_PARK), every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, RV Life park_type city/county rows with no entry within 2 km, and targeted web search
note: Only 5 adds on top of the 27 local entries MO held. Missouri's local campground network really is thin - every instrument (OSM, Good Sam, RV Life, which lists just 30 city/county parks statewide) came back small, because Missouri camping is dominated by the state park system, MDC conservation areas, COE lakes and private parks. MDC conservation-area camping is STATE and was logged for the state-gap pass rather than added here. State gap also noted: Long Branch and Taum Sauk state parks absent, Graham Cave/Berry Bend pins suspect.
